why: The 32,000 limit is in the materials, but the attention-fidelity degradation claim is unsupported; the number itself is correct.
sentence: Direct autoregressive deliberation under extended test-time compute encounters clear computational barriers on combinatorial search: even with a generous 32,000-token ceiling, navigating complex backtracking dead-ends exhausts token budgets while degrading attention fidelity over prior board states.

sentence: In contrast, delegating the combinatorial search to synthesized standard-library Python routines resolves all 500 test puzzles with 100\% fidelity in millisecond execution times.

label: no_claim
why: The 20-peer figure is a structural description of Sudoku, not a measured result, and the materials confirm each cell has 20 peers.
sentence: Because standard Sudoku is defined over a regular 20-peer constraint hypergraph with uniform mutual exclusion rules, maximum pseudolikelihood estimation over solved boards simply recovers the local pairwise penalty graph.
